verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms a visual Unity Editor with an inspector that can be extended with custom inspectors, Editor Windows and Property Drawers. It also refers to building scenes and reviewing 3D projects in real time, which implies visual scene authoring. However, none of the evidence describes the scene viewport, prefabs, or composing levels from prefabs as the primary workflow. Missing for 10: documented scene view/viewport, prefab system and nested prefabs, scene composition and level-building workflow docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
